gloss: nominal, in name only, empty title

definitions.explanation: Having a name, title, or status without the corresponding substance, power, or reality. Something that exists only on paper.

examples.japanese: その{委員会|いいんかい}は{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}になっている。
examples.english: That committee has become nominal (exists in name only).

examples.japanese: {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}な{規則|きそく}を{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to review rules that exist only on paper.

examples.japanese: {会長|かいちょう}は{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}で、{実権|じっけん}は{副会長|ふくかいちょう}が{握|にぎ}っている。
examples.english: The chairman is nominal; the real power is held by the vice chairman.

notes:
TYPE: {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character compound)

COMPOSITION:
・{有名|ゆうめい} (having a name) + {無実|むじつ} (no substance)
・{有|ゆう} (have) + {名|めい} (name) + {無|む} (without) + {実|じつ} (substance, reality)
・Literally: "having name, without substance"

USAGE AS NA-ADJECTIVE:
・{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}な{法律|ほうりつ} (a law in name only)
・{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}な{制度|せいど} (a nominal system)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}になる (to become nominal)
・{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}の{存在|そんざい} (nominal existence)
・{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}と{化|か}す (to become empty of substance)

CONTRAST:
・{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}: in name only (negative - implies lacking substance)
・{名実|めいじつ}{共|とも}に: both in name and reality (positive - complete alignment)

CONTEXTS:
Often used for:
・Organizations or committees that no longer function
・Titles or positions without real authority
・Rules or agreements that aren't enforced
・Leaders who are figureheads
